raw.response:
Surya Namaskar, or Sun Salutation, is a sequence of 12 powerful yoga asanas best done early morning on an empty stomach [PROG_Y_001].

Ek complete round consists of two sets, starting with the right leg and then the left [PROG_Y_001].

Each posture is coordinated with your breath, making it a very calming practice that provides a cardiovascular workout, improves blood circulation, helps with weight loss (वजन घटाना), and strengthens muscles and joints [PROG_Y_001].

Anulom Vilom Pranayama ek powerful pranayama hai jo mind ko calm karta hai aur stress relieve karta hai [PROG_P_001]. Iske fayde yeh hain ki yeh body mein Tridoshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) ko balance karne mein help karta hai, aur patience aur concentration ko improve karta hai [PROG_P_001].

Aapke liye ek balanced diet chart available hai [PROG_D_001]. Breakfast mein fried foods ki jagah poha, upma, ya idli lein [PROG_D_001]. Lunch mein 2 rotis, ek bowl dal, sabzi, aur thoda salad khayein [PROG_D_001]. Dinner sabse halka hona chahiye, jaise khichdi ya dal ke sath vegetable stir-fry [PROG_D_001]. 

Din bhar mein kam se kam 8-10 glasses of paani piyein aur processed sugar ya excessive salt se bachein [PROG_D_001]. Snacks ke liye nuts aur seeds ek acha option hain [PROG_D_001].

Kapalbhati, or Skull Shining Breath, is an invigorating pranayama that cleanses the body through active, forceful exhalation and passive inhalation [PROG_P_002]. 

Sit comfortably with a straight spine, take a deep breath in, and exhale in short, powerful bursts while your stomach pumps inwards [PROG_P_002]. Start with a round of 20-30 pumps and do up to 3 rounds with breaks [PROG_P_002]. It stimulates digestion, improves metabolic rate, and aids in weight loss [PROG_P_002]. 

Practice on an empty stomach, preferably in the morning [PROG_P_002]. Avoid it if you are pregnant, have high blood pressure, heart disease, hernia, or epilepsy [PROG_P_002].

Trikonasana (Triangle Pose) is a foundational standing pose that stretches the entire body [PROG_Y_003]. To do it, stand with your feet wide apart, turn your right foot out 90 degrees, and your left foot in slightly [PROG_Y_003]. Exhale as you extend your torso to the right from the hips, place your right hand on your shin, ankle, or the floor, and extend your left arm up [PROG_Y_003]. 

It stretches the hamstrings, hips, and spine while strengthening the legs and core, and helps improve digestion [PROG_Y_003]. Hold for 30-60 seconds, but avoid locking your knees and avoid the pose if you have a headache, low blood pressure, or a neck injury [PROG_Y_003].

Garmi ke liye aap Sheetali Pranayama (Cooling Breath) kar sakte hain. Yeh breathing technique body aur mind par cooling effect deti hai aur hot weather mein perfect hai [PROG_P_004]. 

Isko karne ke liye comfortably baithiye, apni tongue ko tube shape mein roll karke mouth se bahar nikaaliye, aur straw ki tarah slowly and deeply inhale kijiye [PROG_P_004]. Phir tongue ko retract karke mouth close kariye aur nostrils se slowly exhale kariye [PROG_P_004]. Isko 5-10 times repeat karein [PROG_P_004]. 

Yeh body ko cool karta hai, mental aur emotional excitation reduce karta hai, aur hunger aur thirst control karne mein help karta hai [PROG_P_004]. Low blood pressure ya respiratory issues jaise ki asthma wale log isko na karein [PROG_P_004].

Immunity badhane ke liye ek balanced diet zaroori hai [PROG_D_002]. Apne diet mein citrus fruits jaise amla, oranges, aur lemons shamil karein kyunki yeh Vitamin C ke acche source hain [PROG_D_002]. Turmeric (haldi) mein curcumin hota hai, ise milk ya curries mein add karein [PROG_D_002]. Ginger aur garlic bhi bahut faydemand hain [PROG_D_002]. Yogurt gut health ke liye achha hai [PROG_D_002]. Green leafy vegetables jaise spinach (palak) antioxidants se bhari hoti hain aur almonds Vitamin E ka great source hain [PROG_D_002].

Yogi Devvrat is a certified RYT 500 Yoga Alliance instructor with over 15 years of experience, having started his journey in Rishikesh with traditional yoga gurus [PROG_I_001]. 

His teaching style combines classical Hatha yoga and modern Vinyasa flow, with a focus on alignment, breath, pranayama, and meditation [PROG_I_001]. He specializes in therapeutic yoga to help clients manage chronic pain and stress-related ailments [PROG_I_001].

Millets are ancient grains that are gluten-free and rich in fiber, protein, and antioxidants [PROG_D_004]. They are a modern superfood for a healthy lifestyle, helping you stay full longer for weight management and offering a low glycemic index suitable for diabetics [PROG_D_004]. You can easily add them to your diet by swapping rice with millet or making rotis from their flour [PROG_D_004].

You can relax deeply using Shavasana (Corpse Pose) by lying flat on your back with feet apart, arms by your sides with palms up, and eyes closed for at least 5-10 minutes [PROG_Y_004]. Let go of breath control and release tension (*thakaan*), which helps lower blood pressure, calm the nervous system, and fight insomnia [PROG_Y_004]. 

Alternatively, practice Balasana (Childs Pose) by kneeling, sitting back on your heels, and folding forward with your forehead on the floor for 30 seconds to a few minutes using deep, diaphragmatic breathing [PROG_Y_005]. It relieves back pain, calms the brain, and reduces stress [PROG_Y_005].

Dia Malik is a certified clinical nutritionist with a Masters degree in Food and Nutrition [PROG_I_002]. She follows a no-deprivation approach and creates sustainable diet plans that fit your lifestyle and cultural eating habits [PROG_I_002]. 

She specializes in personalized meal plans based on Indian cuisine and has helped over 500 clients with weight management, PCOS, and diabetes through diet [PROG_I_002]. You can book a one-on-one consultation with her on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 4 PM to 6 PM to create a khaane ka plan [PROG_I_002].

Staying hydrated is crucial for overall health as water regulates body temperature, lubricates joints, and helps deliver nutrients to cells [PROG_D_003]. Dehydration can cause headaches, fatigue, and poor concentration, while proper hydration aids in weight management, kidney function, and flushing out toxins [PROG_D_003]. Aim for 8-10 glasses of water per day, sipping throughout the day, and you can infuse it with lemon, cucumber, or mint leaves for better taste [PROG_D_003].
